parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, no death penalty, and gender-reassignment discrimination protection survives; general society is broadly tolerant and hate-crime coverage exists in some regions. But the 2025 top-court ruling reads 'sex' in equality law as biological sex, and the statutory single-sex-spaces code in force since August 2026 reaches changing rooms, hostels, single-sex services and hospital wards — state-imposed, traveller-facing exposures. Police strip-search policy now uses sex at birth; the regional prison guidance permitting identity placement was struck down; and the Joelle case documents ward removal with fatal consequences. Hostile institutions are being enforced efficiently, so 'functioning courts' is not recourse here. No documented pattern of anti-trans violence raises the floor; the ceiling is capped by these universal exposures.
